title: Desi CS Student Survival Dataset
subtitle: Funny synthetic data on hostel, mess, backlogs and placements of CS students
description: 10,000 synthetic Indian CS students x 59 features (hostel, mess reviews, chai, maggi, bunking, CGPA, LeetCode, burnout, placements) plus 48k rows of semester-wise SGPA history and 7 hidden student personas. Designed to practise classic ML: regression, classification, clustering, PCA, NLP, time series, imbalance, missing data and fairness. 100% synthetic - see DATA_DICTIONARY.md and the generator script.

resources.description: Semester-wise SGPA, backlogs and attendance (long format)
Seven ML challenges, baselines and evaluation instructions
